hypotheses.construction_plan: Treat K(n) as a common multiplication kernel. The template K(n)*f(n) is instantiated with f=a to form K(n)*a(n) and with f=b to form K(n)*b(n). The raw expression is the sum of these two instances.
required_assumptions: K(n), a(n), and b(n) are functions of the declared symbol n; multiplication is pointwise.
proof_obligations: K(n)*f(n) with f=a is exactly K(n)*a(n)
K(n)*f(n) with f=b is exactly K(n)*b(n)
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical terms share the factor K(n), so they are instances of a single multiplication template with different right-hand functions.
